name: B.Com. Commerce
overview:
The Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) programme is a three-year undergraduate course designed to equip students with foundational and advanced knowledge in commerce, business management, and finance. This comprehensive programme focuses on developing analytical skills, financial acumen, and managerial abilities that are essential for thriving in the business world.
The curriculum is carefully crafted to cover diverse areas, including accounting, business law, taxation, economics, and entrepreneurship, ensuring that students are prepared for both professional and academic pursuits.

name: B.Com. Logistics (Honours)
overview:
The B.Com. Logistics (Honours) at SRM Institute of Science and Technology is designed to prepare students for careers in the rapidly growing field of Logistics and Supply Chain Management, which plays a vital role in global trade, manufacturing, e-commerce, and business operations. The Programme is offered in collaboration with the Logistics Sector Skill Council (LSC), established under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) through the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). LSC has designed several apprenticeship-based degree programmes in accordance with the UGC Guidelines, with the primary objective of equipping students with the necessary skills and knowledge for gainful employment at the managerial level in the logistics sector. The programme equips students with industry-relevant knowledge in transportation, warehousing, procurement, operations, and supply chain technologies, along with essential managerial and analytical skills.
The B.Com. Logistics (Honours)with AEDP (Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programme) combines academic learning with practical industry training through a one-year apprenticeship with stipend. This industry-integrated approach provides hands-on experience, enhances employability, and develops career-ready professionals capable of meeting global logistics and supply chain industry demands.
eligibility:
•	Students must have passed their 10+2 examination from a recognized board, preferably with commerce or mathematics.
•	A good academic record meeting the institution’s specific criterion is essential.

school.name: School of Mechanical Engineering
school.about:
Mechanical Engineering: Driven by Innovation, Defining the Future
Mechanical Engineering forms the backbone of modern industry, integrating physics, materials science, and engineering principles to design, analyze, manufacture, and maintain mechanical systems. It has played a vital role in shaping human civilization, from early machinery to advanced technologies in automation, robotics, healthcare, and renewable energy.
A B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering provides a strong foundation in core concepts and opens diverse career paths, including Design, Manufacturing, Thermal, Automotive, Aerospace, and Robotics Engineering. With emerging technologies like AI, IoT, and additive manufacturing, mechanical engineers drive Industry 4.0. 
For higher studies, options like M.E./M.Tech., MS, MBA, or research programs enable specialization in advanced and innovative fields.

name: B. Tech  Mechanical Engineering
overview: SRM IST Tiruchirappalli, established in 2021, offers B.Tech Mechanical Engineering (from AY 2025–26) and aims for excellence in education, research, and societal impact.
eligibility: Applicant should have passed in Higher secondary examination (10 +2 pattern) or appearing in Higher Secondary examination in the current academic year with a minimum of 60% aggregate  (3 subjects) in Physics (mandatory) , Mathematics (mandatory) and at least one of Chemistry / Biotechnology / Biology / Computer Science / Information Technology / Informatics Practices / Engineering Graphics / Botany and Zoology as major subjects in regular subjects in regular stream from any board within India, CBSE, ISCE, IB or NIOS.
careerPath: B. Tech Mechanical Engineering graduates have excellent career prospects in design
along with opportunities for higher studies
employment in leading public and private organizations.

school.name: MBA
school.about:
The Faculty of Management at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus, is dedicated to nurturing future-ready business leaders and management professionals. Established with a vision to blend academic excellence with practical industry exposure, the department offers a dynamic curriculum that integrates core management principles with emerging business trends, entrepreneurship, and ethical leadership.
The department offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, including BBA, MBA and PhD designed to equip students with strong analytical, decision-making, and communication skills. The curriculum is regularly updated in alignment with industry requirements and the UGC/AICTE guidelines, ensuring students remain competitive in the evolving global business environment.
With a team of experienced and research-oriented faculty, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and strong industry linkages, the Faculty of Management strives to create a stimulating learning environment. Students are encouraged to participate in case study competitions, internships, management fests, and live projects to gain real-world exposure and build their professional network.

eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university

school.name: BBA
school.about:
The BBA Department at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRM IST Trichy) is a dynamic academic unit focused on developing future business professionals. Established as part of a rapidly growing campus, the department offers a three-year undergraduate programme designed to build strong foundations in management, entrepreneurship, and leadership. The curriculum is structured across six semesters and includes core areas such as marketing, finance, human resources, and operations. 
The department emphasizes practical learning through internships, industry exposure, and skill-based training. Students benefit from seminars, workshops, and interaction with industry experts, enhancing their managerial and analytical abilities. With experienced faculty and modern infrastructure, the department ensures a supportive academic environment. 
SRM IST Trichy also provides placement opportunities, with companies recruiting students and offering competitive salary packages. Overall, the BBA department aims to nurture competent, innovative, and industry-ready graduates.

school.name: School of Computing
school.about: The future of computing is fostered by the School of Computing Technologies. The school's mission is to advance, develop, and improve the foundations of computer science and engineering in order to contribute to society's intellectual capital. The school aspires to be a significant hub for computers and its applications development on a regional, national, and worldwide scale. It is succeeding by staying abreast of current developments and exhibiting signs of explosive and exponential expansion. Throughout their studies, the students are exposed to a wide range of opportunities, including workshops, internships, and in-plant training. The school is very open to highly promising initiatives including faculty development programs, industry-based joint project creation, hackathons, semester-abroad programs, NSS, etc. on a regular basis.

name: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Block Chain Technology
overview: Blockchain is a concept or protocol that maintains an immutable and distributed digital ledger that attracts many business, industrial, and other real-time use cases that involve recording and tracking transactions. This futuristic technology has become the focus of the industrial and research communities. The department offers a B.Tech. in CSE with a specialization in Blockchain Technology to impart diligent knowledge in the Blockchain landscape. This student body is fortified with necessary traits pertaining to Blockchain technology to address complex problems, which is the need of industrial demand.
